shared_elements: snake-like or curved linear animal forms
rows of repeated abstract rectilinear signs
justification: The strongest correspondence is the combination of schematic profile animals—especially bird-like figures—small discs, snake-like curves, and repeated rectilinear signs organized in horizontal registers. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a dense lower scene with a large winged bird/scorpion-like and human-like forms, while B has a different vertical sequence of panels with large birds/quadrupeds and more separated emblematic motifs.
